headline: Funchal is the city where buying a home weighs most on family budgets
summary: An Idealista analysis finds housing in Funchal absorbs 115% of household net income, the highest strain for buying a home in Portugal. In Madeira, rent takes 99% of household income.
why: Housing affordability shapes household spending, mortgage demand and the outlook for the residential property market. Idealista is a Spanish property portal that publishes such analyses.
